notes.title: Small Update #1
notes.content:
[h1][u][b]Small Update #1[/b][/u][/h1]

As request by a member of the forum i have added a mute button for the moans.

Some UI Anchor points have also been fixed.


[u][b]Patch Notes[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] [u]Added[/u] Moan Mute
[*] [u]Fixed[/u] UI Anchor Points
[/list]

[i]Thank you and happy gaming![/i]

notes.title: Thank You!
notes.content:
I just wanted to spend a little bit of time writing this just to thank all our supporters and testers who helped during the development of GIRL X. Without your help the game would not be what it is, so i thank you all so much for the help!

[h1]THANK YOU SO MUCH![/h1]
